transcript: It's not hard. It's just new. Let me say this again. It's not hard. It's just new. A young student once came to me and said, Master, this feels impossible. I asked him, Was walking hard when you were a child? He said, Yes. I smiled. No. Walking was not hard. It was new. This is the way of life. People start a business and say, It's too hard. People try to heal and say, It's too hard. People learn a new skill and say, It's too hard. But what they really mean is, I have never done this before. The mind fears unfamiliar paths. It wants comfort. But nothing grows in comfort. The bamboo spends years growing roots before anyone sees it rise above the ground. Does that mean it is failing? No. It is preparing. The same is true for you. Every mistake is teaching. Every challenge is training. Every uncomfortable moment is helping you grow. One day, what feels difficult today will feel natural, not because the path became easier, because you became stronger. So when your mind says, This is hard, gently remind yourself. It is not hard. It is just new. And if your mind has been carrying too much stress and noise, I created the monk's 30-day mind rest journal to help you find more peace, clarity, and calm. You can find it in the link on my profile. Follow for more wisdom and comment. Peace below.
